run_add_new_models: run the script to interactively add a new model to a LiteLLM proxy server
run_make_request: run make_request to POST model configuration data to the proxy server /model/new endpoint
run_get_user_input: run get_user_input to interactively collect model parameters like tpm, rpm, api_key, and api_base
run_get_initial_config: run get_initial_config to interactively collect the proxy base URL and master key
run_main: run main to loop through adding multiple models to the LiteLLM proxy server
